axes.label: Self root and snare removal by shapeshifting

notes: Shapeshift Paralyzing Shots, cleanse Mass Envenom, and use Vortex to help the tank kite Ravenous Descendants.
Typhoon and Incapacitating Roar are stops, while Solar Beam supplies the actual spell-school interrupt and silence.
Remove Corruption covers Toxic Spew and shapeshifting removes Bloodthorn Roots from the Druid.
The self cleanse does not free other players; cleanse or external control remains group coverage.
Shapeshifting clears eligible Frigid Roar and Glacial effects on the Druid; Remove Corruption handles Curse or Poison applications.
Bear Form is also used for the dungeon's Druid interaction, but that interaction is not represented as a combat capability.
Remove Corruption handles Curse of Doom and Soothe removes Fel Rage.
No guide-backed shapeshift-removable effect is asserted for this dungeon.
Cleanse Poison Splash, Mind-Numbing Poison, or Corrosive Essence; shapeshift Violent Sand.
Typhoon and Vortex can disrupt eligible Shell Guard or Mending Void enemies; Soothe is situational and can be wrong if an Enrage increases damage taken.
Remove Corruption covers named Poison and Curse effects; Typhoon can stop A Knot of Snakes and Vortex can contain eligible tormentors.
No guide-backed Enrage or shapeshift-removable effect is asserted.
Cleanse Poison Nova, Hex, Lingering Fluid, or Serpent Strike and use Typhoon or Vortex on Animated Gold.
Do not Soothe Ancestral Fury because its downside benefits the party; use Soothe on Bestial Berserk instead.
Typhoon can disrupt Flaming Barrage or Ice Shield; the guide does not list a Curse, Poison, or Enrage answer here.
Cold Claws is a possible self shapeshift target, but the guide treats it as unlikely to select the Druid.

recommendations: Typhoon and Incapacitating Roar can control multiple orbs; Solar Beam is not the default answer to moving orbs.
Swap immediately to the priority enemy and contribute burst damage.
Use Druid mobility to collect another player's orb without crossing the group unpredictably.
Remove Corruption can dispel two eligible applications during the duration; shapeshifting can remove the Druid's own eligible application, with healing as fallback.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of gamz's Patch 12.1.0 Balance Druid dungeon utility guidance. It stores compact recommendations and spell IDs, not guide prose, rankings, talent strings, or comments.
